name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A user-facing Codex to Web LLM conversation bridge with visible browser discovery, ChatGPT/DeepSeek adapters, safe relay modes, and local Codex execution.

interface.shortDescription: Connect the current Codex task to a visible web AI.
interface.longDescription: Codex ↔ Web LLM Conversation Bridge connects the current Codex task to ChatGPT Web, DeepSeek Web, and future web-LLM adapters without exposing browser ports or routing IDs. It discovers visible browser instances, presents windows/tabs/conversations by human-readable names, supports one-shot, manual link, bounded relay, and continuous goal modes, verifies the destination before every send, and provides a two-column conversation UI in hosts that support UI resources. It never reads passwords, cookies, API keys, private endpoints, or hidden chain-of-thought.
defaultPrompt: Open the two-column web bridge panel inside this Codex conversation.
Connect this Codex conversation to a visible web AI.
Ask the connected web model one question or relay the current Codex task.
Use Brain-Hand mode when the web model should plan/review and Codex should execute the current conversation goal locally.
